description: Winner-takes-all sentiment market on Solana devnet (Anchor 0.32): creators open markets with 2 to 10 sides, bettors back a side, the side with the most SOL wins. Sol.College runs this lab on its own fork.
demonstrationNotice: Sol.College-owned demonstration on the Blockchains/sentient.send fork. The upstream author (JB1HEY) has not joined Sol.College and there is no partnership; fixes are offered upstream as ordinary pull requests and acceptance here is by Sol.College's own reviewer, not by the upstream project.

scope: Anchor program correctness on the Solana runtime (create_market, place_bet, claim_winnings, claim_creator_fees)
Frontend reliability of the hosted devnet app at sol.college/dapps/sentient-send/
QA: localnet fixtures and negative cases
exclusions: Changes to the upstream repository other than ordinary pull requests
Security disclosure in public (security findings go to private channels)

assignments.title: Market questions over 32 bytes fail because the question is a PDA seed
Frontend does not type-check (MarketWithPrices drift); export builds with type errors ignored
